# Booqable

Booqable is a rental software platform that helps businesses manage inventory, bookings, and online reservations.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/booqable/.

## Actions

- **Create Customer**: Create a new customer.
- **Create Order**: Create a new order.
- **Get Customer** (read-only): Fetch a specific customer by id.
- **Get Customers** (read-only): Retrieve a list of customers.
- **Get Order** (read-only): Retrieve a specific order by id.
- **Get Orders** (read-only): List all orders.
- **Get Product** (read-only): Fetch a specific product by id.
- **Get Product Groups** (read-only): Retrieve a list of product groups.
- **Get Products** (read-only): Retrieve a list of products.
- **Create Product Group**: Create a new product group in booqable.
- **Delete Customer**: Delete (archive) a customer by id.
- **Delete Order**: Delete (archive) an order by id.
- **Delete Product Group**: Delete a product group by id.
- **Get Product Group** (read-only): Fetch a specific product group by id.
